The mill it self is cool on its own even with out the CNC kit, i played around with it a lot before i converted it so you don't really need to have all the cash right away. I can achieve -/+0.02mm with a bit of attention reliably. Hardest cut it can take reliably is about 10x10mm in 6061 aluminum. Was able to surface steel with a 63mm cutting head at depth of 1mm reliably.

Construction is cast iron and it weighs about 120ish kg. By dissembling the head and table its easy to put the base on a work bench and put it back together with no crane available. Or you can do it with a friend and some chains.
